card.title: RANGOON
card.text: Rangoon, capital of the British colony of Burma, was captured by Japan in March 1942.
card.flavorText: Rangoon, also known as Yangon, is the capital of the Yangon region and the largest city of Burma (also known as Myanmar). Burma was under British rule from from 1885 to 1948, but during WWII it became a major battleground between the Axis and Allied powers. Japan, in coalition with the Burma Independence Army, took control of Burma in 1942 and stayed in power until the Allied forces launched a series of offensives in 1944, and after intense fighting they managed to end the Japanese occupation. Many Burmese fought on the Allied side with the British Burma Army, and many that initially fought on the side of Japan switched allegiance to the Allied side as the war progressed.
